properties.label: 桐柏县
properties.basis_note: 国家非遗项目介绍将桐柏列为盘古神话的流传地区，内容涉及开天辟地与体化万物。此点仅代表县域传承关联，不定位开天现场。
properties.basis_note_en: The national heritage entry identifies Tongbai as a region transmitting Pangu creation myths. This county reference point represents a living tradition, not a creation site.

evidence.title: 盘古神话（桐柏县，国家级非遗Ⅰ-57）
evidence.title_en: Pangu myths: Tongbai national heritage entry I-57
evidence.publisher: 中国非物质文化遗产网

evidence.title: 浅谈桐柏淮源文化
evidence.title_en: On the culture of the Huai headwaters in Tongbai
evidence.locator: 正文引述盘古与淮渎段
evidence.locator_en: Passage associating Pangu with the Huai River

account.summary: 桐柏县文化说明将盘古身体化生的意象与淮河源头联系，转引古籍中的化血为淮河说法。
account.summary_en: Tongbai cultural commentary links Pangu’s bodily transformation to the Huai headwaters through a quotation attributed to an ancient text.
account.limits: 这是地方文化说明的转引；古籍版本未独立核对，也不能据此认定该母题只在桐柏流传。
account.limits_en: This is a local commentary’s quotation. Its ancient edition is not independently checked, and the motif is not established as exclusive to Tongbai.

properties.label: 泌阳县
properties.basis_note: 泌阳为盘古神话国家非遗项目申报地区，项目介绍记述当地流传的创世故事。此点仅代表县域传承关联，不定位开天现场。
properties.basis_note_en: Biyang is a registering county for the national Pangu myth heritage project. This point represents county-level transmission, not a creation site.

evidence.title: 盘古神话（国家级非遗代表性项目Ⅰ-57）
evidence.title_en: Pangu myths: national intangible cultural heritage, I-57
evidence.publisher: 中国非物质文化遗产网

evidence.title: 盘古乡（街道简介）
evidence.publisher: 泌阳县盘古乡人民政府
evidence.locator_en: Township introduction: passage on Mount Pangu
evidence.excerpt: 传说为盘古开天辟地居住之地

account.focus_en: A creation dwelling associated with Mount Pangu
account.summary: 盘古乡政府简介把当地盘古山与盘古开天、居住的传说联系起来，重点是故事与山名的地方关联。
account.summary_en: The township introduction associates local Mount Pangu with a tradition of Pangu’s creation and dwelling.
account.limits: 资料没有提供完整开天故事异文；县域代表点不定位盘古山山顶，也不能与桐柏版本判定互斥。
account.limits_en: No full narrative variant is supplied. The county point is not the summit, and this account does not exclude the Tongbai association.

properties.label: 长子县
properties.basis_note: 长治市政府的发鸠山介绍记述当地与精卫神话的联系。沿用长子县代表坐标，不把县域点当作发鸠山山顶或填海位置。
properties.basis_note_en: Changzhi government describes Mount Fajiu in Changzi in connection with Jingwei. The county reference coordinate is retained; it is neither the mountain summit nor a sea-filling location.

evidence.title: 发鸠山
evidence.excerpt: 这里所说的“西山”即指发鸠山

account.focus_en: Carrying wood and stones; a memorial tradition
account.summary: 长治市政府介绍把精卫衔取木石的西山解释为当地发鸠山，并记述灵湫庙与炎帝纪念女娃的传说。
account.summary_en: Changzhi’s account identifies the mountain supplying Jingwei’s wood and stones with local Mount Fajiu, and records a temple tradition commemorating the drowned daughter.
account.limits: 这是现代地方介绍中的解释与传说，不能由庙宇或县域坐标证明填海发生地点。
account.limits_en: These are interpretations and traditions in a modern local account; neither a temple nor a county coordinate establishes where the event occurred.

properties.label: 高平市
properties.basis_note: 寺庄镇政府工作综述记述当地发鸠山承载精卫传说。沿用高平市区域代表坐标，不作为寺庄镇、山顶或事件现场坐标。
properties.basis_note_en: Sizhuang government records a Jingwei tradition associated with local Mount Fajiu. The existing Gaoping regional coordinate is retained, not a township, summit or event-site coordinate.

evidence.title: 寺庄镇2024年工作综述之文旅康养篇
evidence.publisher: 高平市寺庄镇人民政府
evidence.locator: 第二节：依托历史人文，擦亮旅游名片
evidence.locator_en: Section 2: local historical and cultural resources
evidence.excerpt: 发鸠山不仅承载着精卫填海的神话传说

account.focus_en: A transmission association with Mount Fajiu
account.summary: 寺庄镇政府将镇西北部的发鸠山列为承载精卫传说的地方文化资源。
account.summary_en: Sizhuang government identifies Mount Fajiu northwest of the township as a local cultural resource associated with the Jingwei tradition.
account.limits: 该资料说明当地存在传承关联，没有讲述完整异文；不能仅因山名相同就断定与长子所指为同一山体或故事版本。
account.limits_en: This documents an association, not a full variant. A shared mountain name alone does not establish the same physical mountain or narrative as Changzi’s account.

evidence.title: 千古文明开涿鹿：黄帝、炎帝、蚩尤三祖融合
evidence.title_en: Zhuolu traditions and interpretations of Banquan
evidence.publisher: 河北省民族事务委员会
evidence.locator_en: Paragraph discussing the location of Banquan

account.focus_en: Spring name and the Zhuolu interpretation
account.summary: 河北省民委文章通过转引古籍，介绍把阪泉解释在涿鹿县东南的地望说。
account.summary_en: The Hebei commission article cites earlier texts to describe an interpretation placing Banquan southeast of Zhuolu.
account.limits: 转引古籍并不等于核验古战场；本项目未独立核对原刻本，也不把县域中心当作战场。
account.limits_en: Citing earlier texts does not verify a battlefield. Original editions are not independently checked, and the county center is not a battlefield coordinate.

evidence.title: 千古文明开涿鹿：黄帝、炎帝、蚩尤三祖融合
evidence.title_en: Zhuolu traditions and interpretations of Banquan
evidence.publisher: 河北省民族事务委员会
evidence.excerpt: 似乎也与黄帝、炎帝阪泉之战有关
evidence.locator_en: Paragraph discussing the location of Banquan

account.focus_en: Village names and the Yanqing candidate
account.summary: 同一文章提到延庆张山营镇上下阪泉村，并以保留语气讨论村名与阪泉之战的可能关联。
account.summary_en: The same article mentions Upper and Lower Banquan villages in Yanqing and cautiously suggests a possible association with the battle.
account.limits: 文章本身没有确证村名对应事件；同名地名不足以认定战场，仍保留考证候选身份。
account.limits_en: The article does not establish the association. A shared place name is insufficient to identify a battlefield; this remains a hypothesis.
